PaginationRoot.description: A `<nav>` labelled "Pagination" that holds the current page and works out which pages and ellipses to show. Its context gives `page`, `pageCount`, `items` (the entries to render, each with a stable `key`) and `setPage`; render the items from a component inside it.

props.page: The current page, from 1. Pass it with `onPageChange` to control the page, or read it from the URL for link-based pagination. It is clamped to the pages there are.
props.defaultPage: The page shown first, when the page isn't controlled.
props.onPageChange: Called with the new page when an item, Previous or Next button is pressed, in a change of its own: it may be an action that fetches the page without holding the control. Links don't call it; following them changes the page.
props.count: The number of items being paged through. With `pageSize` it gives the number of pages. Ignored when `pageCount` is given.
props.pageCount: The number of pages, when it is known directly.
props.siblingCount: Pages shown on each side of the current one.
props.boundaryCount: Pages always shown at the start and at the end.

PaginationItem.description: A button that goes to one page. It is labelled "Page N" for assistive technology; pass your own `aria-label` to translate it. For a link, spread `paginationItem(use pagination, { value, href })` on an `<a>`.

props.value: The page it goes to: an entry's `value` from the root's `items`.

dataAttributes.data-current: Present on the current page, beside `aria-current="page"`.

PaginationEllipsis.description: A `<span>` that stands for the pages an ellipsis entry skips. It is `aria-hidden`: the page numbers on either side already say that pages are skipped.

PaginationPrevious.description: A button that goes to the previous page, disabled on the first. For a link, spread `paginationPrevious(use pagination, { href })` on an `<a>`: disabled, it has no `href`, `role="link"` and `aria-disabled="true"`.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present on the first page, or when there are no pages.

PaginationNext.description: A button that goes to the next page, disabled on the last. For a link, spread `paginationNext(use pagination, { href })` on an `<a>`: disabled, it has no `href`, `role="link"` and `aria-disabled="true"`.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present on the last page, or when there are no pages.
